findings.evidence: Determinacy.lean:191-194 and :201-210; the goal after `filter_upwards` is `Polynomial.eval x p = OfNat.ofNat 0 x`, and the final rewrite leaves `0 = (0 : ℝ → ℝ) x`.
findings.fix: Replace the trailing `rfl` with an explicit `simp [Pi.zero_apply]` (or add `Pi.zero_apply` to the rewrite chain), and factor the shared chain into one helper lemma, e.g. `eval_eq_zero_of_zero_H_eq : x ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → |xi| ≤ 1 → (Model.zero Flavor).H i x xi t = (polynomialModel p Flavor).H i x xi t → p.eval x = 0`, used by both branches.
findings.issue: Both ae-disagreement branches end `rw [← polynomialModel_H_of_mem_Icc …, ← hx, Model.zero_H]` followed by a bare `rfl` (lines 194 and 210). After `Model.zero_H` the only remaining gap is `(0 : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ → ℝ) x`, i.e. delta-unfolding of the `Pi`/`OfNat` zero — `rw`'s own reducible `rfl` does not close it, which is exactly why the explicit `rfl` is there. The same three-rewrite chain is also duplicated verbatim across the two branches.

findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma Model.zero_E (Flavor) (i) (x xi t) : (Model.zero Flavor).E i x xi t = 0 := rfl` next to `Model.zero_H` and use it in `assumptions_zero`; in `assumptions_polynomialModel` discharge `supportE` with `simp [polynomialModel]` (or an analogous `polynomialModel_E` lemma) rather than `rfl`.
findings.issue: `Model.assumptions_zero` proves the `H` obligations through the `@[simp]` unfolding lemma `Model.zero_H` but discharges the `E` obligations with bare `rfl` (lines 196 and 197), unfolding the `Model.zero` structure field directly; there is no `Model.zero_E`. Same pattern at Determinacy.lean:123, `supportE := by intro i x xi t _; rfl`, where `polynomialModel`'s `H` does go through `polynomialModel_H_of_mem_Icc`.

findings.evidence: Determinacy.lean:146-151; `Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right : t ⊆ s → s ∩ t = t` at Mathlib/Data/Set/Basic.lean:838.
findings.fix: Drop `congr 1` and rewrite the index set directly: `rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset_right (Icc_subset_Icc (by norm_num) le_rfl)]`.
findings.issue: `mellinMomentH_polynomialModel` closes with `congr 1` on an equality of set integrals, reducing to an equality of restricted measures, then `rw [Set.Icc_inter_Icc]; norm_num` on `Icc (max (-1) 0) (min 1 1)`. `congr 1` on `MeasureTheory.integral` is brittle (it depends on how the application is split and can leave `HEq`/instance goals), and the `max`/`min` normalisation is incidental.

summary: Proofs are mostly short and well-factored, but three spots rest on undocumented definitional equality (bare `rfl` closing `(0 : ℝ) = (0 : ℝ → ℝ) x`, and `rfl` on `Model.zero`/`polynomialModel` `E` fields where an unfolding lemma is the established convention), and one `congr 1` on set integrals is avoidable. The duplicated three-rewrite chain in the last theorem should be a helper lemma.
